requirements.text: * You have an undergraduate/graduate degree in computer science or equivalent experience in engineering, a related technical field.
* 1–3 years of experience in software engineering, distributed systems, cloud services, or a related area.
* Experience building projects through coursework, internships, research, or personal work.
* Working knowledge of one or more programming languages, such as Go, Python, or Rust, along with an interest in learning new technologies.
* Interest in machine learning, generative AI, distributed systems, data infrastructure, or developer platforms.
* Strong communication skills and a willingness to collaborate across teams and disciplines.
